prompts.categories: Use case: product-mockup. Create a square 2048x2048 food category photography sprite sheet for an Indian food delivery website. A precise 4 columns by 4 rows grid of 16 equal square cells, no borders and no text. Each cell has one distinct complete plated dish centred, isolated on pure white with ample white padding and a soft short shadow. Studio food photography, appetising natural ingredients, consistent overhead three-quarter camera angle and scale, not illustrations. Read row-major left to right: row 1 chicken dum biryani in a black bowl, margherita pizza whole, cheeseburger, steamed momos with red chutney. Row 2 North Indian paneer curry thali with naan, masala dosa with idli and chutneys, Chinese wok noodles in a bowl, grilled paneer wrap cut in two. Row 3 chocolate brownie with gulab jamun, three ice cream scoops in a bowl, mango milkshake and iced coffee, colourful quinoa salad bowl. Row 4 aloo paratha with curd, grilled club sandwich, creamy penne pasta, samosas with chaat. Every dish stays fully inside its own cell with no overlapping between cells. No writing, logos, watermarks, cutlery crossing cells, or background props. Layout must remain exactly a 4x4 equal-cell grid.
prompts.biryani: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset: transparent food artwork for the right half of a Dropbell offer slider. Photorealistic premium advertising cutout of a generous black bowl of chicken dum biryani with separate fluffy saffron and white rice, fresh mint, golden fried onions, with a small bowl of raita and two lemon wedges arranged around it. Slightly elevated three-quarter view. Appetising realistic food photography, warm studio light, crisp detail, a few mint leaves near the composition, compact balanced arrangement, generous padding all around. Isolate everything on a genuinely transparent background. No text, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no hands. Do not invent branding.
